cases.action_sequence: Create, switch, and close tabs. Cancel, save, and discard a dirty tab. Use overflow, middle-click, and digit jumps.
cases.expected_results: Each tab keeps its own body. Closing one dirty tab does not close another. The selected accent is neutral under an overlay.
cases.forbidden_effects: A reused index activates a different tab.
